purpose: Test a prospectively fixed finite short completed-U1 production interval after the C10.65s2k one-step entry certificate. Use the identical frozen completion point, four low-k anchors, production kernel, state ownership, approximation criteria and perturbation tolerance. Advance over an interval fixed before execution to 100 times the C10.65s2k retry width, retain adaptive Cash-Karp bookkeeping, require finite terminal state and bounded terminal preferred A/H/momentum normalized residuals. This is an endpoint short-interval stability certificate only; it does not bound the unobserved intra-step peak residual or establish full-time evolution.

execution.rejected_trial_policy: measure and report; no post-hoc rejection-count bound

prospective_constraint_policy.rationale: Frozen before s2l execution. The bound is approximately seven orders of magnitude above the largest one-step normalized drift measured in C10.65s2k (~6e-16), leaving substantial floating-point accumulation margin while still rejecting macroscopic departure from the algebraic constraint manifold.

interpretation_if_pass: On the frozen one-completion-point x four-low-k domain, the completed-U1 production path remains finite and on the preferred A/H/momentum constraint manifold at the end of a prospectively fixed ~3.54e-8 Mpc interval spanning at least ten accepted adaptive substeps per anchor, with unchanged equations and perturbation tolerance. This is a finite-short-interval endpoint certificate only.
next_if_pass: Freeze a separate trajectory-resolved constraint-stability gate that records preferred A/H/momentum residuals at every accepted substep before widening time span, k coverage or completion-parameter coverage.
non_claims: not a reclassification of original C10.65s2
not an intra-step or accepted-step peak constraint bound
not a UV derivation of higher UR hierarchy
